rq1.finding: Do not endorse unconditional FRESH placement for every pre-effect or in-request exchange. The original scoped Check already refuses current-context rollover for Reserve, Record_Launch_Intent and Record_Running. That supports the proposed refusal for the concrete first-launch route, but does not prove the placement for every accepted retained reserve/replay/recovery caller. A single-frame flat embedding cannot establish the whole original scoped domain. No accepted first-launch rollover counterexample was established in this passive review.
rq1.required_change: Provide command-by-command and caller-by-caller domain correspondence. Apply current-context checks only where the original native command requires them; design Retained_Join for every required retained-origin path, and retain positive rollover controls. Keep RQ-1 and the original obligations OPEN until that mapping and evidence exist.

domain_risks.finding: G3 and the unspecified multi-frame variant leave the declared total embedding incomplete. Raw-domain-only exclusions cannot narrow the original quantified domain.

The multi-frame/multi-bucket refusal vectors do not specify an invalid predicate. Qualify the exact violated condition and include genuinely valid multi-frame/multi-bucket positives; neither shape alone is a new refusal.

Mandatory FRESH socket cookies and namespace records can add a provider restriction. Explicit non-ready status does not preserve an originally accepted case; establish profile coverage or an authentic domain-preserving design. No new live-client/pidfd requirement is introduced.
Unconditional J1/J3/J4 are inconsistent with J8's socket-free retained/historical modes. Mode-specific presence and request/operation/transaction joins must be explicit.
PREPARED-no-HELD release must exclude any dispatched/possibly-launched case; retained RESULT_CAPTURE recovery must not acquire an extra HANDLER_TERMINAL prerequisite.

preserved: Exact v1 frontier control remains enrolled; no lead-only retirement or re-enrollment acceptance.
No accounting option is selected, and any authoritative policy change retains D-4a operator selection.
Original proof floors, original rosters, cases, references, fixture thresholds and controls are retained as obligations; no capped domain or accepted refusal is authorized.
Every original Phase One obligation remains OPEN.
conclusions: Design is directionally domain-preserving but cannot be endorsed unchanged. Named unresolved statuses and open obligations are disclosures, not permission to refuse original accepted cases.
